name: Otter Centurion
flavor: Slick armor plates lashed from birch bark — first through the gate, first to slide back out.

name: Ent
flavor: A walking watchtower of oak and moss. Takes its time. The enemy usually doesn’t.

name: Dolphin Knight
flavor: Rides the moat like open water. Lance first, questions never.

name: Bee Knight
flavor: Small, shiny, and extremely offended by trespassers.

name: Bee Drone
flavor: Struck once, and a swarmling boils out immediately to keep the line held.

name: Caustic Scorpion
flavor: Wooden tank tread bolted to a scorpion’s tail. The sting lingers long after the tread stops.

name: Yeti
flavor: Less a warrior, more a siege engine that occasionally roars. Give it five turns to get moving.

name: Scraper of Skies
flavor: A hive-tower lashed together from ladders, rope and prayer. Strike it, and it answers with bees.

name: Bee Swarmling
flavor: Not drafted, not bought — just spilled out of something bigger when it was struck.

name: Forager Ant
flavor: Carries three times its body weight in acorns, and slightly more in grudges.

name: Soldier Ant
flavor: Mandibles built for one purpose. It has never once used them for anything else.

name: Ant Hill
flavor: A city of tunnels dressed as a hill, taxing every passing beetle for the war effort.

name: Otter Scout
flavor: Whiskers first, pockets second. Always comes back from the riverbank with something shiny.

name: Otter Shieldback
flavor: Carries a driftwood shield strapped to its back. Slides into position, then doesn’t move.

name: Owl Fletcher
flavor: Feathers cut for silence, arrows cut for the same.

name: Owl Sentinel
flavor: Turns its head all the way around so nothing behind the line goes unwatched.

name: Great Horned Owl
flavor: Talons like grappling hooks. The moment it wakes, something in the enemy line already regrets it.

name: Terrier Pup
flavor: Too small to be scary. Nobody told it that.

name: War Hound
flavor: Strapped into leather barding before it could properly walk. Hasn’t stopped since.

name: Armored Mastiff
flavor: Built like a battering ram with slightly better manners.

name: Alley Cat
flavor: Nine lives, and it’s spending every one of them recklessly.

name: Bramblewood Lynx
flavor: Tufted ears, silent paws, and absolutely no patience for a slow fight.

name: War Panther
flavor: Camouflage stripes that were never really necessary — it’s simply faster than being seen.

name: Bramblewood Macaque
flavor: Steals rations, steals weapons, occasionally wins the fight anyway.

name: Silverback Brawler
flavor: Doesn’t so much fight a line as flatten the whole thing at once.

name: Trapdoor Spider
flavor: Waits under a hinged lid of moss and silk. The wait is the whole strategy.

name: Webspire Sentinel
flavor: A watchtower spun from silver silk. Nothing crosses its threads unnoticed — or alone.

name: Compost Grub
flavor: Slow, squishy, and somehow always still standing at the end of the round.

name: Tunnel Wyrm
flavor: Surfaces exactly where the enemy line least expects a worm.

name: Gorge Wyrm
flavor: A worm the size of a siege engine, because someone fed it entirely too well.

name: Cricket Drummer
flavor: Its chirp is the marching cadence for half the Bramblewood infantry.

name: Carrion Fly Swarm
flavor: Small, numerous, and deeply unpleasant to be surrounded by.

name: Monarch Wingblade
flavor: Wings edged in something sharper than pollen, and toxic besides.

name: Bramble Sprout
flavor: Barely a seedling. Somehow already armed.

name: Thornvine Lasher
flavor: Grows a foot a minute when there’s something worth wrapping around.

name: Fungal Colossus
flavor: A mushroom the size of a shed. When it finally topples, spores take root where it fell.

name: Elder Willow
flavor: Roots older than the castle it now leans protectively over, and just as slow to give anything up.

name: Ember Wisp
flavor: Barely more than a floating spark. Throws one wild ember the instant it arrives.

name: Tide Spirit
flavor: Formless, patient, and impossible to properly hit.

name: Stoneheart Golem
flavor: Assembled from castle rubble and something that might be actual magic. Nothing soaks in.

name: Gale Sprite
flavor: You hear it before you see it. Mostly you just hear it.

name: Stormcaller
flavor: Calls down exactly one bolt the moment it wakes. It is never a wasted one.

name: Minnow Skitter
flavor: Nearly weightless. Nearly worthless. Somehow still shows up to every fight.

name: Pike Lancer
flavor: A living spear with fins. Subtlety was never the plan.

name: Pufferfish Bulwark
flavor: Doubles in size the moment anything gets close. Its own toxins never touch it.

name: Reef Shark
flavor: Circles the battlefield once, then bites through however much line is in the way.

name: Quillguard
flavor: Rolls into a ball of very bad ideas for anyone who tries to grab it.

name: Komodo Warlord
flavor: Patient, armored, and in absolutely no hurry to lose. The bite is the least of the problem.

name: Raccoon Bandit
flavor: Washes its loot in the moat before deciding whether to keep it.

name: Raccoon Warlord
flavor: Every raid it survives gets buried a little deeper. Cutting it down just means someone else digs up the hoard.

name: Badger Berserker
flavor: Digs in, then digs in further. Nobody has successfully asked it to leave.

name: Beetle Battering-Ram
flavor: A shell like a shield wall, lowered and driven straight through the middle of one.

name: Crocodile Ambusher
flavor: Floats like driftwood right up until it very much doesn’t.

name: Raven Scout
flavor: Circles once, marks a target, and dives before anyone finishes reading the omen.

name: Wolf Pack Runner
flavor: Never fights alone if it can help it. Fights anyway if it can’t.

name: Boar Rampager
flavor: Does not so much choose a target as choose a direction.

name: Turtle Bastion
flavor: Brings its own fortifications. Nothing about it is in a hurry.

name: Chipmunk Skirmisher
flavor: Cheeks stuffed with acorns, morale, and absolutely nothing resembling caution.

name: Eagle Diver
flavor: Announces itself with a strike, and only then with a screech.

name: Octopus Tactician
flavor: Eight arms, eight opinions on how this fight should go. Usually gets its way.

name: Nautilus Drifter
flavor: A living fossil that has been quietly hoarding pearls since long before this castle was built.

name: Alpha Howler
flavor: One howl and the whole tree line answers. It rarely fights alone, and it rarely needs to.

name: Tusked Vanguard
flavor: Small, angry, and completely uninterested in which direction anyone else is running.

name: Snapper Hatchling
flavor: Barely bigger than a coin, already wearing full plate. Give it a few decades.

name: Chipmunk Stockpiler
flavor: Cheeks packed with acorns it insists are for winter. The war chest disagrees.

name: Eyrie Warden
flavor: Watches from a height nothing else can reach, then arrives before the watching is noticed.

name: Badger Sapper
flavor: Tunnels under the wall instead of over it. The wall rarely notices until it's too late to matter.

name: Raven Harbinger
flavor: Its call is an old, bad omen. Whatever it lands on tends to prove the omen right.

name: Bear Cub
flavor: All paws and no plan. The plan arrives in a year or two.

name: Woodland Brawler
flavor: Settles every argument the same way: badly, loudly, and in its own favor.

name: Grizzly Vanguard
flavor: One swipe was always going to hit more than one target. Nobody told the line to stand so close together.

name: Cave Warlord
flavor: Wakes up exactly once a fight, and the ground remembers it for longer than that.

name: Fawn Scout
flavor: Freezes first, bolts second, and somehow still ends up exactly where the fighting is.

name: Antler Skirmisher
flavor: Rack of antlers sharpened on every gatepost between here and the tree line.

name: Stag Knight
flavor: Winters on the high ridge alone. Nothing about a battlefield chill bothers it much.

name: Elderhorn Monarch
flavor: The oldest set of antlers in the Bramblewood. Even the raccoons pay it tribute.

name: Fox Kit
flavor: Quick teeth, quicker exit. Rarely still there by the time you've noticed the bite.

name: Firetail Trickster
flavor: Nine tales, one of them true, and a tail that's genuinely on fire. Ask it which is which.

name: Fox Warchief
flavor: Never fights the fight in front of it — always the two or three fights just past that one.

name: Beaver Builder
flavor: Shows up already carrying a stick it clearly means to sell you back later.

name: Dam Wall
flavor: Built in an afternoon out of whatever was lying around. Somehow still standing next spring.

name: Lodge Engineer
flavor: Never stops building, never stops taxing everyone downstream for the privilege.

name: Riverworks Bastion
flavor: A fortress of logs and mud that has outlasted three winters and at least one siege.

name: Grass Viper
flavor: You won't see it in the grass. You'll just start feeling it a moment later.

name: Adder Ambusher
flavor: Coiled and patient right up until it very much isn't.

name: Constrictor Coil
flavor: Doesn't so much attack a line as wrap around the whole thing at once.

name: Venomlord Serpent
flavor: Immune to its own venom, which is the only mercy anyone's ever found in it.

name: Cave Flitter
flavor: Impossible to hit in a straight line, mostly because it refuses to fly in one.

name: Echo Screecher
flavor: Finds you by sound alone, which is somehow worse than finding you by sight.

name: Bat Swarmling
flavor: Not drafted, not bought — just one more shape that peels off the roost when it's disturbed.

name: Vampire Roost
flavor: Knock it down and the whole colony scatters at once, still very much looking for dinner.

name: Field Mouse
flavor: Slips through the pantry, the granary, and eventually the war budget.

name: Mouse Sapper
flavor: Too small to stop, too determined to bother trying to stop.

name: Rodent King
flavor: Crowned by acclamation of every mouse in the granary. The granary has a lot of mice.

name: Stable Colt
flavor: Not trained for war yet. Kicks like it already is.

name: Squire's Mount
flavor: Carried a squire into three skirmishes before the squire caught up to it in nerve.

name: Warhorse Charger
flavor: Barding, blinders, and absolutely no intention of slowing down for the enemy line.

name: Cataphract Destrier
flavor: Armored nose to tail in wood-fired steel. The rider is almost beside the point.

name: Puddle Hopper
flavor: Croaks once before every fight. Nobody's figured out if it's a warning or a taunt.

name: Poison Dart Croaker
flavor: Small, brilliantly colored, and a genuinely terrible idea to touch.

name: Bog Behemoth
flavor: Older than the castle, wider than the moat, and in absolutely no hurry to leave the mud.

name: Warren Scout
flavor: Out of the burrow and back in it before anyone's sure it was ever there.

name: Lucky Hopper
flavor: Carries a foot that isn't its own for luck. Doesn't ask where the previous owner went.

name: Buck Brawler
flavor: Kicks first, apologizes never. Mostly because there's rarely anyone left to apologize to.

name: Hanging Loafer
flavor: Took four rounds just to open its eyes. Worth the wait, mostly.

name: Ancient Sloth Titan
flavor: Has been hanging from that same branch since before the castle had a name. In no rush to change that.

name: Pond Paddler
flavor: Looks entirely unbothered above the waterline. Paddling furiously the whole time underneath.

name: Mallard Marauder
flavor: Comes in low over the water and hits harder than something this size has any right to.

name: Glacial Ape-King
flavor: The Yeti's elder. Rarely leaves the high passes, and the passes are grateful for that.

name: Sand Widow
flavor: Weaves its web between two dunes and waits exactly as long as the desert does.

name: Orca Vanguard
flavor: Hunts in a pack that never needs to be told the plan twice.

name: Quill Volley
flavor: Doesn't wait to be grabbed. Fires first and rolls into a ball to think it over later.

name: Stone Turtle Warden
flavor: Nothing wrong with a slow answer, so long as it's the same answer every time: no.

name: Quill-Thorn Boar
flavor: It never learned to dodge. It never had to.

name: Berserker Boar
flavor: Wounded, it stops defending entirely. That is not recklessness. That is the plan.

name: Pack Wolf Reaver
flavor: One howl, three targets down. The pack was never really three wolves — just one idea, worn three ways.

name: Raven Hexcaller
flavor: It doesn't fight the blade. It just quietly convinces the arm holding it that swinging sounds exhausting.

name: Eagle Sharpshooter
flavor: Its first shot lands before it's finished landing. The arrow is not the point — the eye is.

name: Hawk Arrowkeeper
flavor: Two arrows, always. One for the target, one for anyone thinking of helping.

name: Shrine Acolyte
flavor: Every dawn, the same quiet request. Most gods ignore it. This one apparently doesn't.

name: Shrine High Priest
flavor: Arrives already mid-sermon. Somehow, the shrine's coffers are heavier for it.

name: Blessed Avatar
flavor: Gold can't buy this one a place on the field. Devotion, apparently, can.

name: Hollow Oath-Keeper
flavor: It asks for a name, not gold. Whichever card you hand over doesn't come back.

name: Bone Diviner
flavor: It reads the fallen for omens, then quietly removes them from the story. Every kill it makes afterward pays for the reading.

name: Insect Swarmling
flavor: One bite. Barely worth noticing. There will be more.

name: Colony
flavor: Strike it once, and a thousand more answer.

name: Nest
flavor: The first one out of the nest always flies a little faster.

name: Howler Monkey
flavor: Announces every ambush loudly, in advance, on principle.

name: Jaguar Stalker
flavor: The canopy does not rustle. Then it is already too late.

name: Toucan Courier
flavor: Trades gossip and acorns at a very favorable exchange rate.

name: Poison Dart Frog
flavor: Small, bright, and a genuinely terrible idea to lick.

name: Strangler Vine
flavor: Started as a houseguest. Now it is load-bearing.

name: Acacia Giraffe
flavor: Sees the whole fight coming from a very comfortable distance.

name: Savanna Cheetah
flavor: Already at the HQ by the time the wait timer means anything.

name: Dust Hyena
flavor: Laughs last, laughs loudest, keeps the change.

name: Termite Mound
flavor: Looks like scenery. Fights like a fortress.

name: Plains Zebra
flavor: The stripes are not camouflage. They are a dare.

name: Snow Owl Sentinel
flavor: Silent wings, a very good memory for who owes it a hit.

name: Tundra Musk Ox
flavor: The herd forms a wall. This one IS the wall.

name: Arctic Fox Raider
flavor: White on white on white, gone before you register the crunch of snow.

name: Permafrost Mammoth
flavor: Thawed out ill-tempered and has not warmed up since.

name: Ice-Crevasse Wolf
flavor: Every bite leaves something that keeps bleeding long after the fight moves on.

name: Clownfish Scout
flavor: Small, orange, and somehow always exactly where the hit was headed.

name: Coral Reef Shark
flavor: Circles once out of professional courtesy. Then does not.

name: Moray Ambusher
flavor: Lives in a hole in the reef and in your nightmares, respectively.

name: Sea Turtle Elder
flavor: Has outlived several reefs. Intends to outlive this fight too.

name: Coral Polyp Colony
flavor: Builds itself one grain at a time, and never once stops billing for it.

name: Mountain Goat Climber
flavor: Footing that should not exist, used with total confidence.

name: Golden Eagle Diver
flavor: Stoops from a height that makes the math feel unfair.

name: Alpine Avalanche
flavor: Started as a pebble. Nobody agrees on whose fault that was.

name: Rockslide Ram
flavor: Charges downhill. Somehow charges harder every time.

name: Peak Condor
flavor: One devastating pass, then a long climb back to altitude.

name: Bog Leech
flavor: Attaches, drains, and is philosophically opposed to letting go.

name: Swamp Alligator
flavor: Ninety percent patience, ten percent an extremely bad day for someone.

name: Mire Witch-Heron
flavor: One long stare and the fight already looks worse for you.

name: Marsh Gas Toad
flavor: Swells, glows faintly, and gives everyone a two-round warning it counts on you ignoring.

name: Cypress Root Lurker
flavor: Rooted so deep the ground itself seems to be taking the hit.

name: Cave Bat Swarm
flavor: One bat is a nuisance. This is never just one bat.

name: Blind Cave Fish
flavor: Cannot see the attack coming. Dodges it anyway, out of habit.

name: Stalactite Golem
flavor: Falls. Lands. Reconsiders its posture for a round. Falls again.

name: Glowworm Cluster
flavor: Lights the tunnel and, somehow, the collection plate.

name: Deep Cave Troll
flavor: Calm right up until it very much is not.

name: Magma Salamander
flavor: Cooled just enough to hold a shape. Not enough to be safe to touch.

name: Ash Cloud Condor
flavor: A wingbeat of ash and grit — the first thing anyone opposite it does is cough and freeze.

name: Obsidian Scorpion
flavor: Glass-edged and doubly unkind about it.

name: Sulfur Vent Crab
flavor: Lives somewhere that would kill almost anything else instantly. Unbothered.

name: Fire Drake Hatchling
flavor: Too young to fly. Old enough to already be a problem.

name: Taiga Lynx
flavor: Tufted ears, silent paws, an opinion about your flank.

name: Boreal Elk
flavor: Antlers wide enough to clear a path through anything in the lane.

name: Pinecone Sapper
flavor: A very short fuse dressed up as forest litter.

name: Snowshoe Hare
flavor: Built entirely out of not being where the hit lands.

name: Timber Wolf Pack Leader
flavor: Howls once. Every wolf on the line stands a little taller.

name: Tide Pool Crab
flavor: Small, sideways, and surprisingly hard to actually pinch out of a fight.

name: Gull Thief
flavor: Steals the kill credit and the sandwich, in that order.

name: Riptide Eel
flavor: One vicious pull, then it needs the current to reset.

name: Barnacle Fortress
flavor: Technically alive. Technically a wall. Extremely thorough about the second part.

name: Pelican Diver
flavor: Folds up, drops like a stone, comes back up with something it should not have.

name: Mangrove Mudskipper
flavor: Neither fully a land animal nor a water one. Fully unbothered by the distinction.

name: Mangrove Monitor
flavor: Patrols the root-tangle like it personally issued the property deed.

name: Fiddler Crab Swarm
flavor: One waving claw is a threat display. A thousand is a tactic.

name: Mangrove Kingfisher
flavor: A blue-and-orange blur that was never actually where you swung.

name: Gangrenous Leech
flavor: Fester: the longer its own poison sits in its veins, the harder the next bite lands.

name: Wound Reaver
flavor: Rupture: it opens a wound, then swings again harder for every drop already spilled.

name: War-Drum Mandrill
flavor: Every drumbeat is a standing order — the whole line hits harder while the drummer lives.

name: Swarm Matriarch
flavor: Esprit 1: every fresh Insect that joins the swarm makes the Matriarch hit that much harder.

name: Feral Tuskboar
flavor: Berserker: every hit it survives just makes it angrier — and considerably less survivable to fight.

name: Ravenous Wolverine
flavor: Bloodlust 2: it does not slow down once it starts swinging. It speeds up.

name: Trickster Fox
flavor: Scurry: slips in and swaps two enemies’ places on the field before anyone notices the ground moved.

name: Old-Growth Tortoise
flavor: Regenerate 2 (invented): moss, bark, and old scar tissue knit back together every single round it’s left standing.

name: Shimmerwing Stag
flavor: Its antlers catch light that hasn't reached this glade yet.

name: Open-Ocean Hermit Crab
flavor: Small, sideways, and surprisingly hard to actually pick a fight with.

name: Reef Manta Glider
flavor: Barrel-rolls through the surf as if the fight were a suggestion.

name: Narwhal Lancer
flavor: The tusk arrives first. The rest of the argument follows.

name: Humpback Elder
flavor: Old enough to remember when this reef was someone else's territory.

name: Dune Jackal
flavor: Crosses open sand faster than the heat has time to punish it for.

name: Sandstorm Roc
flavor: Arrives as weather. Leaves as a body count.

name: Frost Hare Sprinter
flavor: White fur, quiet feet, and absolutely no intention of being caught.

name: Glacier Wolf Pack
flavor: Every bite is a promise the cold will finish collecting on.

name: Porcupine Roller
flavor: Curls into a ball. The ball has opinions about being kicked.

name: Quillback Elder
flavor: Decades of bad decisions, made by other people, against this exact hide.

name: Trash Panda Trickster
flavor: Found something shiny in the battlefield rubble. Sold it back to you.

name: Raccoon Nightcrew
flavor: Never seen entering the castle. Only ever seen leaving it, richer.

name: Honey Badger Fury
flavor: Famously does not care. Especially not about your health total.

name: Badger Trench Digger
flavor: Dug in so deep the whole lane leans on it without asking.

name: Chipmunk Hoarder
flavor: Every cheek pouch is, technically, a savings account.

name: Chipmunk Cavalry
flavor: Small, fast, and inexplicably first into every fight anyway.

name: Cuttlefish Illusionist
flavor: By the time the color pattern registers as a threat, it already isn't there.

name: Kraken Spawnling
flavor: Small for its family. The family is not a useful comparison.

name: Slowpoke Sentinel
flavor: Has not moved in three rounds. Has also not taken meaningful damage in three rounds.

name: Canopy Sloth Guardian
flavor: Slow to arrive, impossible to move once it has.

name: Duckling Squadron
flavor: In a row. Always in a row. Somehow that is the scary part.

name: Migration Leader
flavor: Points south. The whole flock gets stronger just for following.

name: Otter Riverguard
flavor: Holds the ford so the rest of the raft can cross.

name: Owl Nightwatch
flavor: Sees in the dark. Flies through the gaps everyone else swears aren't there.

name: Shepherd's Bark
flavor: Puts itself between the flock and the problem, every single time.

name: Feral Tomcat
flavor: Territorial, uninvited, and somehow already attacking before the round starts.

name: Rootworm Colony
flavor: Quietly ruins the soil, the roots, and eventually your whole strategy.

name: Pack Rat Looter
flavor: Checks the pockets. Every single time, without fail.

name: Camouflage Frog
flavor: Was that a leaf? It was not a leaf.

name: Jackrabbit Sprinter
flavor: Across the field and back before the wait timer even means anything.

name: Shrine Bell-Ringer
flavor: One clean note, and the whole congregation feels a little more devout.

name: Ember Jackal
flavor: One bite is a warning. It only ever gives warnings in pairs.

name: Magma Titan
flavor: It doesn't forget a hit. It just waits until the next one to answer both.

name: Phoenix Fledgling
flavor: Every scar it should have kept, it burns off by morning.

name: Basalt Boar
flavor: Charges the biggest thing in the room. Gets harder to kill for trying.

name: Pyroclast Wyrm
flavor: Molten breath doesn't care what you're wearing.

name: Barrow Leech
flavor: Drinks first. Asks questions never.

name: Coral Current Eel
flavor: A small bite. A slow, patient problem.

name: Frost Thistle Lynx
flavor: Claws first. Warmth never.

name: Dune Jackal Scout
flavor: Doesn't outrun the sun. Just outlasts it.

name: Sulfur Cinder Moth
flavor: Circles the light until the light stops being safe for anyone.

name: Glacier Yak
flavor: It leans into every charge. The frost leans in right behind it.

name: Nightshade Moth
flavor: The powder from its wings doesn't sting. It just asks, very persuasively, that you lie down.

name: Voltaic Eel
flavor: Every current in the river remembers where it's been.

name: Cinder Hornet
flavor: It doesn't sting to hurt you. It stings so you'll stop moving long enough to notice the smoke.

name: Elder Tortoise
flavor: Its shell has outlasted three generations of otters who swore they'd finally crack it.

name: Maggot
flavor: Not drafted, not bought — just what the carcass left behind.

name: Rot-Swollen Carcass
flavor: It stopped moving on its own days ago. Everything still living inside it hasn't noticed yet.

name: King Maker
flavor: Doesn't want the crown. Wants whoever's wearing it to have a very bad day.

name: Training Dummy
flavor: Doesn't hit back. Doesn't do anything, actually.

name: Punching Bag
flavor: Absorbs a lot of hits. Testers love it. It has feelings, probably.

name: Glass Cannon
flavor: One hit and you're done. Both ways.

name: Kitchen Sink
flavor: Carries Armor, Pierce, Flying, and an On Attack poison proc all at once, on purpose — for testing how several mechanics stack together, not for balance.

name: Training King
flavor: A cheap, disposable King -- for testing King Slayer without dragging the real Rodent King or Glacial Ape-King into it.

name: Otter Kit
flavor: Paddles circles around anything twice its size, mostly out of nerves.

name: Otter Paddler
flavor: Keeps to the current. The current keeps it moving.

name: Otter Guard
flavor: Stands watch at the lodge gate, otter-scout style.

name: Honey Bee
flavor: One sting, one job, one very short life.

name: Bee Forager
flavor: Returns to the hive with more pollen than sense.

name: Bee Sentry
flavor: Doesn't sting first. Doesn't have to ask twice, either.

name: Worker Ant
flavor: Carries, digs, hauls. Never once complains.

name: Tunnel Ant
flavor: Knows six ways out of anywhere it's ever been.

name: Ant Scout
flavor: First to notice trouble. First to report it, loudly.

name: Silver Minnow
flavor: Small, quick, and gone before you decide it matters.

name: Pond Trout
flavor: Idles in the shallows until the moment it doesn't.

name: River Carp
flavor: Bigger than it looks from the bank.

name: Duckling
flavor: Follows whoever moved first. Usually works out.

name: Pond Duck
flavor: Unbothered, unless you're near the nest.

name: Duck Paddler
flavor: Calm on the surface. Paddling hard underneath.

name: Meadow Rabbit
flavor: Freezes first, runs second, rarely needs a third option.

name: Cottontail
flavor: Fast enough that "catch it" is mostly a suggestion.

name: Burrow Rabbit
flavor: Comes up swinging when the den's the last option.

name: Chipmunk Forager
flavor: Cheeks full, plans somehow fuller.

name: Acorn Chipmunk
flavor: Buries acorns it will absolutely never find again.

name: Cobalt Talon Fledgling
flavor: Not cleared for border patrol yet. Practices anyway.

name: Crimson Wing Recruit
flavor: Feather-red is earned, not born. This one's still earning it.

name: Mosswing Laborer
flavor: Builds the nests the war never stops needing.

name: Gold-throated Acolyte
flavor: Learning the calendar-oaths one verse at a time.

name: Violet Vane Fletcher
flavor: Trims feathers for flight, not for fashion — mostly.

name: Sunthroat Courier
flavor: Carries messages the Dominion would rather you not read.

name: Voidfeather Scout
flavor: Flies the routes with no moon in them.

name: Crimson Wing Duelist Cadet
flavor: Practice bouts only. For now.

name: Cobalt Talon Skirmisher
flavor: Faster than the wind it rides.

name: Dominion Nestguard
flavor: Sunfeather-born, lodge-sworn to no one.

name: River Warden
flavor: Every otter that finishes the run remembers three things: the grip, the current, and who taught them both.

name: Sunspire Envoy
flavor: It didn't win the race. It watched everyone else run it, then it went.

name: Quarry Mole
flavor: Waits on a resource nobody can spend yet. When Stone finally counts for something, this one will already know how.

name: Swipe Filler
flavor: A disposable 1/1 with no skills of its own -- spawn a few to fill out flanks when testing Swipe, Sweep, or any other multi-target skill.

name: Test: Poison
flavor: Carries only Poison -- stacks poison on every landed attack -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Armor
flavor: Carries only Armor -- reduces incoming damage on every hit -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Thorns
flavor: Carries only Thorns -- reflects flat damage back at melee attackers -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Swipe
flavor: Carries only Swipe -- also hits both flanking columns -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Sweep
flavor: Carries only Sweep -- also hits the next live card(s) down the flank -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Rage
flavor: Carries only Rage -- below 50% HP: double damage dealt, half taken -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Expose
flavor: Carries only Expose -- marks its target for bonus damage on the next hit it takes -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Guardian
flavor: Carries only Guardian -- redirects hits aimed at an adjacent ally onto itself -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Quick
flavor: Carries only Quick -- attacks before every non-Quick attacker -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Reload
flavor: Carries only Reload -- sits out extra round(s) after attacking -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Shell
flavor: Carries only Shell -- getting hit queues bonus armor + a skipped attack next round -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Stealth
flavor: Carries only Stealth -- ignores targeting -- always hits the enemy HQ directly -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Evasive
flavor: Carries only Evasive -- a flat 1-in-2 chance to dodge any incoming single-target hit -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Crit
flavor: Carries only Crit -- chance per round to double all damage dealt that round -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Fester
flavor: Carries only Fester -- bonus attack damage equal to its own poison stacks -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Rupture
flavor: Carries only Rupture -- bonus attack damage equal to its own bleed stacks -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Bleed
flavor: Carries only Bleed -- stacks bleed on every landed attack -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Skyfall
flavor: Carries only Skyfall -- on spawn, crashes down for damage on a random live enemy -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Esprit
flavor: Carries only Esprit -- gains permanent Attack when a shared-archetype ally enters play -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Regeneration
flavor: Carries only Regeneration -- heals itself every round it is on the board -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Stun
flavor: Carries only Stun -- chance per landed attack to Stun the target -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Pierce
flavor: Carries only Pierce -- punches flat bonus damage through to the enemy castle on every melee hit -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Gash
flavor: Carries only Gash -- On Spawn: bleeds the opposing creature once -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Overwhelm
flavor: Carries only Overwhelm -- carries a killing blow's leftover damage through to the enemy castle -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Berserk
flavor: Carries only Berserk -- gains permanent Attack whenever any ally dies -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Bulwark
flavor: Carries only Bulwark -- reduces damage your Castle takes while this card is on the field -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Reflect
flavor: Carries only Reflect -- chance to throw the full damage of a melee hit back at the attacker -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Momentum
flavor: Carries only Momentum -- gains permanent Attack every time it lands a killing blow -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Bloom
flavor: Carries only Bloom -- heals a random damaged ally every round it is on the board -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Ambush
flavor: Carries only Ambush -- its first attack after entering play always crits and cannot be evaded -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Siege
flavor: Carries only Siege -- deals bonus flat damage when its attack lands directly on the castle -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Corrode
flavor: Carries only Corrode -- stacks corrode (decaying Attack reduction) on every landed attack -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Inherent Darkness
flavor: Carries only Inherent Darkness -- generates Dark Points every round while Ready -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Core Evil
flavor: Carries only Core Evil -- generates a Dark Point the moment it is pitched -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Frenzy
flavor: Carries only Frenzy -- attacks a second time in the same round if still alive -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Rend
flavor: Carries only Rend -- melee hits completely ignore the target's Armor -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Flying
flavor: Carries only Flying -- airborne -- immune to Earthquake and other ground-only AOE -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Earthquake
flavor: Carries only Earthquake -- On Spawn: damages every non-Flying enemy creature -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: King Slayer
flavor: Carries only King Slayer -- deals bonus damage on every landed hit against a King -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Explode
flavor: Carries only Explode -- a ticking fuse that detonates for damage once it reaches 0 -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Freeze
flavor: Carries only Freeze -- chance per attack to Freeze the target (no Wait tick, cannot attack) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Sleep
flavor: Carries only Sleep -- chance per attack to put the target to Sleep (breaks on any damage taken) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Paralyze
flavor: Carries only Paralyze -- chance per attack to Paralyze the target (fresh coin-flip every round) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Blind
flavor: Carries only Blind -- chance per attack to Blind the target (its own attacks auto-miss) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Shock
flavor: Carries only Shock -- chance per attack to Shock the target (takes 50% more damage) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Chained
flavor: Carries only Chained -- spawns unable to attack until its chain-break condition fires -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Render
flavor: Carries only Render -- On Spawn: permanently lowers the opposing creature's Attack -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: Revivificated
flavor: Carries only Revivificated -- first death instead revives at 1 HP with cleared statuses -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Test: On Death: Spawn
flavor: Carries only On Death: Spawn -- On Death: spawns a Training Dummy onto this row -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Trigger Test: Spawn Strike
flavor: A plain Custom Trigger, nothing else: On Spawn, deals 5 damage to the opposite creature. For testing the trigger system itself in isolation from any named skill.

name: Trigger Test: Mender
flavor: A plain Custom Trigger, nothing else: Per Turn, heals itself for 3. For testing the trigger system itself in isolation from any named skill.

name: Test: Stagger
flavor: Carries only Stagger -- has a chance per landed attack to Stagger the target (-50% damage dealt) -- and nothing else, for testing this one mechanic in isolation. Not for balance.

name: Bonebreaker
flavor: Every blow lands like a falling tree. The ones who get back up wish they hadn't.

name: Bee Tank
flavor: When the hive runs dry, this is what crawls out instead.

name: Wandering Traveller
flavor: No banner, no faction — just a walking stick, a full pack, and a knack for showing up exactly when a new adventure needs a guide.
